# Open Mercy

> Free browser card game with the No Mercy ruleset: draw stacking, Draw 6, Draw 10, Skip Everyone, Discard All, Color Roulette, 7 swap, 0 rotate and elimination at 25 cards. Real-time multiplayer for 2 to 20 players, or solo against AI. No download, no account required.

Play now: [open-mercy.com](https://open-mercy.com/)

## About

Open Mercy is an independent, open-source web game. Its ruleset was popularized by Mattel's UNO Show 'Em No Mercy card game; this project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Mattel or the UNO brand. The last-card call in Open Mercy is "Mercy!".

- Free to play, no ads inside the game
- No download or installation, runs in any modern desktop or mobile browser
- Guest play; an optional free account saves stats, ranks and friends
- 2 to 20 players per room, with a room code or invite link
- Solo mode against a ladder of AI opponents, plus a daily deal that everyone plays on the same shuffle
- Open source under the MIT license: [github.com/alii13/open-mercy](https://github.com/alii13/open-mercy)

## Rules implemented

- Draw 2, Draw 4 (colored), Wild Draw 6, Wild Draw 10 and Wild Reverse Draw 4
- Draw stacking: the host picks official (equal or higher), house (wilds stack on anything) or casual (anything stacks)
- Skip, Skip Everyone, Reverse
- Discard All (drop every card of one color at once)
- Wild Color Roulette (draw until the named color appears)
- 7 swap (trade hands with any player) and 0 rotate (every hand moves one seat)
- Mercy rule: a hand of 25 or more cards is eliminated; the last player standing wins
- Last-card call with a catch window; getting caught costs 10 cards

- [Stacking rules](https://open-mercy.com/rules/stacking/): which draw cards stack on which

- [Strategy](https://open-mercy.com/strategy/): tips for the No Mercy ruleset
- [FAQ](https://open-mercy.com/faq/): accounts, multiplayer, devices and fixes
- [Leaderboard](https://open-mercy.com/leaderboard): top players and the daily board
